name: Qube Browser 0.5.1
notes:
0.5.1
Fixed:
* Updates no longer fail right after you press Update

0.5.0
New:
* Notes: text notes and whiteboards, as tabs and in the Library
* Command bar with 60 commands, and Ask AI
* Qube Spark: chat with Claude or ChatGPT
* Streaming Space: a Space with a tile per streaming service
* Little Qube: links from other apps open in a small window
* Spotify as music source, next to Apple Music
* Per profile: search engine, download folder and extensions
* Full keyboard and Narrator support
* Settings in the Windows 11 style
* Works on PCs without a graphics card, such as Windows 365 Cloud PCs

Improved:
* Tabs not used for an hour are unloaded to save memory
* Windows from your last session reopen at start

Fixed:
* Permission questions and page dialogs no longer get lost
* A tab moved to another Space right after opening keeps its page
summary: Notes, a new command bar, a Streaming Space, and support for PCs without a graphics card.

mac.name: Qube for Mac 0.10.15
mac.notes:
New:

* Everything under the Space's name scrolls as one list, as in Arc, with a thin line under the name once scrolled
* The top of a page drags the window only where nothing is under the pointer, not over a text field, button, link or stream

Fixed:

* Liquid Glass with Frost kept the graphics chip busy (60 to 70 %); now it rests
* Chrome's colour, date and time pickers open under their field instead of far outside the window, and stay open when clicked
* A split pane's bar takes the colour of the top of its page, also on sites that declare white (such as CIPP)
* A split in a tab group sits in line with the group's tabs
* Tidy Downloads renames only names that are codes or numbers, and no longer adds a year or a web address
mac.summary: The whole sidebar scrolls as Arc's, Liquid Glass with Frost no longer strains the graphics chip, and Chrome's colour and date pickers open where they belong.
